name: storage-speed-verify-v1
description: Destructive NVMe speed+verify profile. Capacity-based sequential 2M write with 16 workers at QD8 each plus CRC32c verify. Optimized for throughput while doubling as a write-cliff, garbage-collection/folding, and sustained profiling detector. CAUTION: overwrites all data on the DUT. Requires --destructive flag and serial re-entry confirmation.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. SMART, OCP, and NVMe identity artifacts captured at run start.

phases.name: speed-verify
phases.notes: Capacity-based sequential 2M write + CRC32c verify, 16 workers at QD8 each. Phase ends when fio finishes the device; 86400s is only a safety ceiling. High-speed destructive profiling for data integrity plus pSLC cliff / garbage collection / folding / sustained write collapse.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 3 min cooldown. SMART and OCP health captured at run end, compared to pre-run.
